description: One of a subscription's limits, as Claude Code's get_usage says it, or Codex's App Server's rate limits (account/rateLimits/read).

key.description: The limit's own name in Claude Code's usage (five_hour, seven_day…); a Codex limit's, by its window's length (five_hour and seven_day as Claude's, else 2_hour, 3_day…).

resets.description: When it resets, in seconds since 1970 (left out where the usage doesn't say).

percent.description: How much of it is used, in percent.
